plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, hired him to talk to aliens, told podcast host Jesse Michels about two gray aliens (small gray-skinned beings) he calls "Bones" and "Spock." He says this was in the 1990s, in a programme he calls Project Preserve Destiny, and that he thinks they were soldiers of a kind, though not military. If true, it would mean the US government had a working line of contact with aliens who had their own chain of duty.
